notes: Places, not countries. Axes 0-4 are judgments with public-index flavor, not a 7-nines forecast. legal_ease is separate (Swedish citizen work-right) and must not be smuggled into 'best life'.
critic: Sweden-first was a cash-path cheat code (citizenship), not evidence that Stockholm is the best city to grow character, friends, or pay.
Nordics are one reserved-winter cluster. Treating them as four depth slots double-counts the same social cost.
Estonia is a work-right (EU) and a digital brand, not a fortress-employer or friend-graph environment.
Europe is not a place. Eindhoven and London are different civilizations.
America is not a place. Austin and the Bay are opposite family/ethics bets that share a visa wall.
Japan grows discipline and safety; it punishes outsider extroversion. Do not pick it for friends.
Singapore is a high-function hub with speech/assembly limits and a transient expat graph. Cash yes; character-via-free-speech no.

places.name: Eindhoven (Brainport)
places.why: English-ok engineering city, ASML gravity, Dutch directness, cycling/family. Best blend of growth + legal access for a Swedish citizen.
places.cost: Smaller scene than Amsterdam; still northern-reserved vs Texas.

places.name: Austin
places.why: Easiest US extrovert + Tesla/physical-AI vector, no state income tax, more family-possible than the Bay.
places.cost: Visa wall. Heat. Healthcare. Not an ethics monastery.

places.name: Zurich
places.why: High trust, high pay, safety, ABB/industrial orbit. Character via competence.
places.cost: Reserved like Sweden. Housing brutal. Permit, not a union right.

places.name: Melbourne
places.why: English, outdoor, friends-possible, family-possible. Personality can actually expand.
places.cost: Far from EU family/citizenship option. Weaker fortress-AI bench than NL/US.

places.name: Munich
places.why: Siemens/auto/robotics, family state, Swedish citizen can start. Character via craft.
places.cost: German is the social door. Less English-easy than NL.

places.name: Copenhagen
places.why: Same Nordic family/ethics stack, slightly less frozen-social than Stockholm.
places.cost: Still Jante + tax + wage compress. Not an extrovert machine.

places.name: Oslo
places.why: Sovereign-wealth calm, outdoor character, Kongsberg/energy adjacent.
places.cost: Price and reserve. Friends are slow.

places.name: Stockholm
places.why: Home-market option: fortress industrials + you may work tomorrow. Family machinery is excellent.
places.cost: Dark winters, lagom/Jante, hard outsider-friend graph, compressed SWE pay. Do not confuse legal ease with a thriving social life.

places.name: Singapore
places.why: English hub, safety, Asia robotics/semis, can save.
places.cost: Transient friends, speech limits, housing cost. Growth is professional more than civic.

places.name: Tokyo
places.why: Safety, craft, Fanuc-class robotics. Character via standards.
places.cost: Outsider extrovert is a bad bet. Language is the door. Pay not US.

places.name: Bay Area
places.why: SpaceXAI / frontier network and pay. Horizon city, not a family city.
places.cost: Housing, status politics, weak family default. Visa wall.

places.name: Tallinn
places.why: EU work-right, digital state, cheap relative to SE.
places.cost: No 10-year fortress bench. Small graph. Border risk. Not a personality-expansion city.

places.name: Amsterdam
places.why: Easier friends than Stockholm. English default.
places.cost: More software-as-a-service theater than Brainport. Housing.

places.name: Helsinki
places.cost: Same reserved-winter problem as Stockholm, smaller scene.

places.name: Seattle
places.cost: Reserved US. Rain. Visa. Weaker family than Austin.
